name: radio-group
description: Picks exactly one of 2 to about 5 options, all visible at once; for more options use a select. Compose the parts inside RadioGroup: RadioGroupLabel, one Radio per option, RadioGroupDescription and RadioGroupError (renders only while the choice is invalid), all exported from the radio-group file. Each Radio's value is what onChange reports and the form submits; its children are the option's label.

props.name: ref
props.description: The wrapping element, which has the radiogroup role.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; the form submits the chosen Radio's value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the chosen Radio's value.

props.name: orientation
props.description: vertical stacks the options; horizontal puts them in a row, for short labels only.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Requires a choice before the form submits.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Prevents changes and dims every option.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Marks the choice invalid from outside, e.g. after a server error.

props.name: validate
props.type: (value: string | null) => string | string[] | true | null | undefined
props.description: Returns an error message for an invalid choice, shown by RadioGroupError.

props.name: validationBehavior
props.description: native validates on form submit; aria validates as soon as the choice changes.

example:
<RadioGroup name="plan" defaultValue="pro">
  <RadioGroupLabel>Plan</RadioGroupLabel>
  <Radio value="free">Free</Radio>
  <Radio value="pro">Pro</Radio>
  <Radio value="team">Team</Radio>
  <RadioGroupDescription>You can change it later.</RadioGroupDescription>
</RadioGroup>
